LanguageData.FSFPsychicAttunerDampener.description: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given psychic dampening which blocks all psychic sensitivity for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the psychic attuner.
LanguageData.FSFPsychicAttunerHeatSink.description: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given a psychic heatsink effect which helps rapidly cool neural heat for the user. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the psychic attuner.
LanguageData.FSFPsychicAttunerSensitizer.description: Through the use of the psychic attuner the user has been given extra psychic sensitivity which increases how psychically sensitive the user is. This effect can be removed by reconfiguring the psychic attuner.
LanguageData.LTS_ArchotechHeart.description: An installed archotech heart. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but can somehow pump far more blood throughout the body without putting additional strain on the cardiovascular system. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.
